text: HeelSec presents two papers, GDDRHammer and KeyTAR, at the IEEE Symposium on Security and Privacy, a top-tier venue with a 12.7% acceptance rate.

Featured in arsTechnica for our work on GDDRHammer, a novel attack that exploits vulnerabilities in modern GPUs to induce bit flips in DRAM, demonstrating the potential for cross-component Rowhammer attacks.
